meta.title: Queued evaluation — proposed P17 workflow revision

boundaries.label: Existing worker process — proposed P17 processing responsibilities

cards.title: Acceptance is not completion
items: While the runner lease is valid: verify current auth/fence, frozen trial set, manifest, acknowledged sequence and actual owned exit/cleanup. Cancellation committed first cannot become PASS.
Atomically seal exact inputs, store one job and recoverable acceptance receipt, close new runner writes and return 202. Run remains FINALIZING / NOT_EVALUATED.
Job identity binds attempt, operation/payload digest, input references and evaluator version. Identical authenticated retries recover status; changed payload conflicts and revoked credentials reject.

cards.title: Durable processing and bounded retries
items: Extend the existing control-plane worker with bounded evaluation claims. Each claim has a processing lease/generation and a deadline; a crash leaves durable work for recovery.
Only explicitly transient failures retry, with capped attempts, backoff and an overall time budget. Failure or exhaustion remains inspectable.
A failed assertion is a completed evaluation. Missing, corrupt or invalid evidence remains inconclusive or a defined error; never rerun the scenario or retry until PASS.

cards.title: Required lifecycle change before implementation
items: Today FINALIZING still uses runner lease expiry. Queueing requires an explicit accepted-and-cleaned-up handoff, after which the server job deadline governs processing. Do not keep execution alive by renewing a lease.
Persist the seal/handoff in the existing attempt lifecycle; add job delivery state without duplicating run/attempt or evidence stores. Preserve original terminal rows.
Cancellation during processing and result commit use the same authoritative locks. An expired worker generation cannot commit, and duplicate delivery cannot create a second terminal result.

cards.title: Same infrastructure; proposal awaiting review
items: Job and result boxes represent the same PostgreSQL database. API and worker share application modules; this proposes no broker, new service or hosting change.

Long evidence reads/checks run outside long database transactions. Recheck job generation and run/cancel state in a short final commit. Expiry maintenance continues independently with separate bounded sessions.
P17 reads P16 verified metadata/descriptors, rehashes bounded content and validates semantic bindings. The runner remains NON_EXECUTING / DISABLED / DECLARED.
This revises the earlier synchronous design. Canonical 202/status/terminal receipt contracts, lifecycle migration and cancellation behavior need design review; nothing is implemented or deployed.
